title: Fresh Animations: Extensions
description: A combination of offical extension packs for Fresh Animations
author: FreshLX
body:
[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/freshlx/projects) [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX) [PMC](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/freshlx/) [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/freshlx) [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/FreshLX) [Discord](https://discord.gg/Wxs7JEPMrH) [X](https://x.com/Fresh_LX)
---


![Fresh Animations Extensions](/launcher-preview/bodies/YAVTU8mK/0.webp) Fresh Animations Extensions are extra resource packs with additional features for Fresh Animations.
- Load these packs above Fresh Animations to work correctly. - These packs are mostly suited for the vanilla look and aren't friendly to other resource packs. - These resource packs are made for and usually require Fresh Animations.

Pack Load Order [Go to Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)

---

![Details](/launcher-preview/bodies/YAVTU8mK/1.webp)
This pack is a combination of all my extension packs. See below for details on each extension.


[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-creepers)
Creeper Edit: This FA extension edits the creepers, giving them custom textures and texture variations. Newer versions also add rare model variations. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-details)
Details Add-on: This extension adds a long list of extra model details and texture variations to mobs, including pigs, sheep, cows, chickens and more. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-emissive)
Emissive Add-on: This extension gives emissive textures for some mobs, made specially for Fresh Animations. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-quivers)
Quivers Add-on: This FA extension adds quiver models on the backs of Skeletons, Strays and Bogged, each with a unique texture to match. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-details) (now merged with Details Add-on)
Slamacow Add-on: Adds variants based on characters from Slamacow Creations. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-spiders)
Spider Edit: This FA extension edits the spider models' design to be more detailed and realistic. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-classic-horses)
Classic Horses Edit: This FA extension edits the horses to how they looked in 1.12 and earlier, but with updated textures and animations. The animations in this pack were made almost entirely from scratch, as the over-detailed models don't the animations FA gives the modern horse models. \ preview

[icon go to project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-objects)
Objects Add-on: This FA extension animates non-mob entities like chests, boats, and minecarts in Fresh Animations' style. \ preview

---
[Early Access button](https://ko-fi.com/freshlx/posts)
Early access previews available on Ko-fi with a Golem Tier membership

## Changes:
### Details			
- adjusted files for FA 1.10
- added new model parts and animations no longer included in FA
- updated designs for chicken, pig, sheep, cow, mooshroom for FA 1.10
- added new variants for chicken, pig for FA 1.10
- updated eye textures for FA 1.10

- added tweaked enderman model and textures
- added wolf and cat baby models originally from FA
- slimes are now mostly normal, with a 1/20 chance to have a weird face
- added Cletus
- added a "keyword" file which causes a resource reload fail without FA

### Emissive
- updated textures for FA 1.10
- added bat
- added hoglin and zoglin

### Creepers
- updated textures for FA 1.10
- added rock creeper, mud creeper, skeleton creeper
- tweaked textures
- added a "keyword" file which causes a resource reload fail without FA

### Spiders

- added jaw cubes to head parts
- added animations to parts
- added a "keyword" file which causes a resource reload fail without FA

### Quivers
- adjusted files for FA 1.10
- tweaked design slightly

### Objects
- fixed broken chest models
- overhauled boat anims
- overhauled chest anims
	- separate EMF versions for chests due to OptiFine limitations
- added a button model to trapped chests
- added custom chest textures
- merged minecart anims into one file
- tweaked minecart texture
- added ender chest emissive

### Classic Horses
- more version support
